description: This Java class 'BaseOtaPackageService' implements OTA package management functionalities, including saving, finding, deleting OTA packages, checksum generation, and event handling within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: BaseOtaPackageService
classes.description: Service class for managing OTA packages, including CRUD operations, checksum generation, event handling, and cache management within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: handleEvictEvent
methods.description: Handles cache eviction events for OTA packages.

methods.name: saveOtaPackageInfo
methods.description: Saves or updates OTA package information, with validation and cache eviction.

methods.name: saveOtaPackage
methods.description: Saves or updates an OTA package, with validation and cache eviction.

methods.name: generateChecksum
methods.description: Generates checksum for OTA package data using specified algorithm.

methods.name: getHashFunction
methods.description: Returns the HashFunction corresponding to the specified checksum algorithm.

methods.name: findOtaPackageById
methods.description: Retrieves an OTA package by its ID.

methods.name: findOtaPackageInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves OTA package info by ID with caching.

methods.name: findOtaPackageByTenantIdAndTitleAndVersion
methods.description: Finds an OTA package by tenant ID, title, and version.

methods.name: findOtaPackageInfoByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves OTA package info by ID.

methods.name: findTenantOtaPackagesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds all OTA packages for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findTenantOtaPackagesByTenantIdAndDeviceProfileIdAndTypeAndHasData
methods.description: Finds OTA packages filtered by tenant, device profile, type, and data presence.

methods.name: deleteOtaPackage
methods.description: Deletes an OTA package by ID, handling related data and cache eviction.

methods.name: getDataOidById
methods.description: Retrieves the data object ID associated with an OTA package.

methods.name: unlinkDataIfPresent
methods.description: Unlinks large object data associated with an OTA package if present.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes an entity, specifically an OTA package.

methods.name: sumDataSizeByTenantId
methods.description: Calculates total data size for a tenant.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all OTA packages for a tenant.

methods.name: deleteOtaPackagesByTenantId
methods.description: Removes all OTA packages for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findEntity
methods.description: Finds an entity by ID, returning optional.

methods.name: findEntityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an entity by ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is OTA_PACKAGE.
